web.name: Tracki Web
web.tag: Detect struggles on-site and resolve them before they become tickets.
web.title: Catch the struggle while it's happening
web.subtitle: Real-time struggle detection, behavioral segments and no-code interventions that turn silent frustration into instant self-resolution.
web.b1: Rage clicks, dead ends, error loops and abandoned forms detected within seconds
web.b2: A visual segment builder over live behavioral data
web.b3: Popups, banners and tooltips shipped without engineers
web.featuresTitle: Everything between the first signal and the saved checkout
web.f1D: A rule engine watches every session for rage clicks, dead ends, error loops and abandoned checkouts — and surfaces the silent customers who would have left without a word.
web.f2D: Compose audiences from attributes and behavior — "struggled on checkout, logged in, cart over SAR 200" — with live preview counts.
web.f3D: Author popups, banners, embedded cards and tooltips in Arabic and English with live RTL preview, frequency caps, scheduling and A/B testing.
web.f4D: When a struggle fires, AI matches the exact answer that solves it and offers it on the spot — grounded in your content, never invented.
web.s1D: One tag, under 30 KB, no site rebuild required.
web.s2D: Struggles are detected server-side within five seconds.
web.s3D: An action or Live Assist answer renders instantly, in the visitor's language.

mobile.name: Tracki Mobile
mobile.tag: Behavioral intelligence inside your iOS and Android apps.
mobile.title: See every journey inside your app
mobile.subtitle: OTP loops, failed payments, abandoned onboarding — Tracki detects in-app friction in real time, intervenes with native nudges and Live Assist, and measures the revenue it recovers.
mobile.b1: SDKs for React Native, Flutter, iOS and Android — one wire protocol, one dashboard
mobile.b2: Mobile struggle detection: OTP failure loops, payment failures, app restart loops and more
mobile.b3: In-app modals, guided tours and help drawers that escalate to Arabic AI chat or WhatsApp
mobile.featuresTitle: The same loop, inside the app
mobile.f1D: Nine in-app struggle signals — from biometric failure loops to deep-link dead ends — scored with the same 0–100 friction model as web.
mobile.f2D: A detected struggle answers itself: contextual help drawers grounded in your knowledge base, Arabic-first, escalating to WhatsApp with full context.
mobile.f3D: Every session gets a 0–100 journey score; every screen a friction and abandonment ranking — so you fix what costs the most first.
mobile.f4D: At-risk and recovered revenue cut by screen, struggle type, app version and device type — correlation, honestly labeled.
mobile.s1D: Add the React Native, Flutter, Swift or Kotlin SDK with your existing project key. Events flow within minutes.
mobile.s2D: Screens, funnels and struggles land in the same dashboard as your website — one customer, one timeline.
mobile.s3D: Ship native nudges, guided tours and Live Assist without an app release, and watch recovered revenue accrue.

agent.name: Tracki Agent
agent.tag: Grounded AI chat that answers from your knowledge — and only your knowledge.
agent.title: AI support that knows what the customer was just doing
agent.subtitle: A bilingual conversational agent grounded in your knowledge base and the visitor's live behavior — it cites its sources, and it never guesses.
agent.b1: Arabic and English, tolerant of Gulf, Egyptian and Levantine phrasings
agent.b2: Every answer cites the article it came from
agent.b3: Honest escalation the moment it doesn't know
agent.featuresTitle: A controlled agent, not a creative one
agent.f1D: The Agent may only answer from retrieved knowledge. No retrieval, no answer — it escalates instead of inventing.
agent.f2D: Current page, recent struggles and login state are injected into every conversation, so the Agent asks fewer questions and resolves faster.
agent.f3D: Auto-detects language and register — Gulf, Egyptian and Levantine phrasings included — and replies accordingly.
agent.f4D: Blocked topics, turn limits, PII redaction in logs, and a conversation console with resolution tagging for every transcript.
agent.s1D: The customer asks — or a detected struggle triggers the Agent proactively.
agent.s2D: Answers come from your knowledge base, with the source cited inline.
agent.s3D: Out of scope? It routes to WhatsApp, email or your form — with full context attached.

connect.name: Tracki Connect
connect.tag: Escalate from web to WhatsApp with the full story attached.
connect.title: From stuck on your site to solved on WhatsApp
connect.subtitle: The Gulf's phone culture lives on WhatsApp. Tracki Connect hands conversations over with the customer's full web context — so nobody ever repeats themselves.
connect.b1: One-tap escalation deep-links into WhatsApp with a context token
connect.b2: Operators see pages viewed, struggles and the Agent transcript beside the chat
connect.b3: Tracki Agent answers first; humans take over seamlessly
connect.featuresTitle: The web-to-WhatsApp bridge, end to end
connect.f1D: The thread arrives with pre-contact context — pages viewed, the detected struggle, and a summary of the AI conversation so far.
connect.f2D: Assigned conversations, a behavioral timeline beside every chat, and bilingual canned replies your team fires in one click.
connect.f3D: The Agent handles the first reply on WhatsApp around the clock, and hands over to a human the moment it should.
connect.f4D: Route by topic, segment or language to the right team — no more "press 9 for everything else".
connect.s1D: From the website, the Agent, or any Tracki action.
connect.s2D: A deep link carries a context token — no forms, no inquiry numbers to dictate.
connect.s3D: The inbox shows the chat with the full web journey alongside it.
connect.m1L: average handling time on targeted inquiries
connect.mCaption: SBI Securities, on the web-to-phone context model Tracki Connect reinvents for WhatsApp.

voc.name: Tracki VoC
voc.tag: Turn every conversation into a measurable improvement.
voc.title: Your customers are already telling you what to fix
voc.subtitle: Tracki VoC reads every conversation — Agent, WhatsApp, imports — clusters the pain points with Arabic-aware AI, and turns them into tasks your teams actually close.
voc.b1: Native ingestion from Agent and WhatsApp; CSV and email import for the rest
voc.b2: Topic, sentiment and severity classification tuned for Arabic
voc.b3: Insights become assigned tasks with measurable impact
voc.featuresTitle: From raw voices to closed tasks
voc.f1D: Ingest → mask → classify → cluster, automatically. PII is masked before any analysis and never used for training.
voc.f2D: Related voices cluster together across dialects and spelling variants, surfacing emerging issues while they're still small.
voc.f3D: Volume-by-severity matrices and emerging-issue feeds show exactly where the next fire will start.
voc.f4D: Convert any cluster into a task with an assignee and due date — then watch whether related complaints actually drop.
voc.s1D: From every channel Tracki already owns — plus anything you import.
voc.s2D: Pain points, requests and trends — classified and grouped, in Arabic and English.
voc.s3D: Assigned, tracked, and measured against the complaint volume they were meant to reduce.
voc.m1L: inquiries per month visualized in one deployment
voc.m2L: net revenue retention across the category
voc.mCaption: SBI Securities and category benchmarks from the proactive-support model Tracki builds on.

knowledge.name: Tracki Knowledge
knowledge.tag: Bilingual help content that writes and heals itself.
knowledge.title: A knowledge base that maintains itself
knowledge.subtitle: FAQ CMS, hosted help center and Arabic-aware search — plus an AI loop that spots the gaps and drafts the missing answers for your approval.
knowledge.b1: Side-by-side Arabic/English editor with translation-coverage flags
knowledge.b2: Search that understands hamza, teh marbuta and spelling variants
knowledge.b3: Gap detection drafts new articles — humans approve, never auto-publish
knowledge.featuresTitle: Content your customers — and your AI — can rely on
knowledge.f1D: Categories, tags, versioning and draft/publish — with missing-translation indicators so Arabic and English never drift apart.
knowledge.f2D: A themable, RTL-native help center on your own subdomain, with full-text Arabic-aware search.
knowledge.f3D: Unanswered Agent questions, no-result searches and VoC clusters become AI-drafted article proposals in a human review queue.
knowledge.f4D: Stale and contradicting articles are flagged automatically, with a weekly knowledge-health report.
knowledge.s1D: The same question goes unanswered three times — or a search returns nothing.
knowledge.s2D: A bilingual draft appears in your review queue, grounded in your existing content.
knowledge.s3D: Published in both languages — and the Agent answers it from then on.

platform.name: Tracki Platform
platform.tag: The real-time behavioral data layer every product stands on.
platform.title: AI without behavioral data is just a chatbot
platform.subtitle: Every Tracki product runs on one real-time event pipeline — so every answer, action and handoff knows exactly what the customer was doing seconds ago.
platform.b1: A snippet under 30 KB — no site rebuild, no dependencies
platform.b2: Events queryable within seconds of happening
platform.b3: PII masked at ingestion, before anything is stored
platform.pillarsSubtitle: One pipeline from the visitor's first click to the resolved conversation.
platform.c1D: A zero-dependency snippet streams pageviews, clicks, forms, errors and custom events — with identity merge on login and PII masked at ingestion.
platform.c2D: Struggle rules evaluate in real time, segments update live, and your knowledge is embedded for retrieval — Arabic and English alike.
platform.c3D: Actions, Live Assist, the Agent and the WhatsApp handoff all consume the same live context — grounded answers, zero "please describe your issue again".
platform.f1D: Sub-100 ms ingestion acknowledgment and five-second struggle detection — the live view shows events as they happen.
platform.f2D: All AI calls go through one layer with versioned prompts, full logging, and a mode that refuses to answer without retrieved context.
platform.f3D: Every query is scoped to your organization — enforced in the query layer and verified by automated tests, not by convention.
platform.f4D: Track custom events, identify users, and pull everything back out — your data is yours.

pricing.title: Pricing that scales with you, not against you
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when the volume arrives. Launch pricing — locked in for early customers.

pricing.t1Desc: For trying Tracki on a real site.
pricing.t2f3: Tracki Agent with fair-use AI quota
pricing.a1: Pageviews, clicks, form interactions and custom track() calls. Widget impressions don't count against your quota.

pricing.q3: What do I need for WhatsApp?

security.title: Built for the Gulf's strictest reviewers
security.subtitle: Data residency, privacy and AI safety aren't bolt-ons — they're slice-zero architecture decisions.
security.s1D: Your data is stored region-pinned in the GCC and no service assumes global storage — residency is configuration, not a promise.
security.s2D: Emails, phone numbers (including +966 / +971 / +20 formats) and names are masked before events are ever stored. Raw PII never reaches the analytics store.
security.s3D: Every row carries your organization ID and every query is scoped to it — enforced in the query layer and verified by automated tests.
security.s4D: AI answers only from your retrieved content, every call is logged with its prompt version, and your data is never used to train models.
security.s5D: Conversations, actions and admin changes are logged — with PII redacted from logs by default.
security.s6D: Designed in line with the KSA PDPL and the UAE PDPL. SOC 2 Type II is on the certification roadmap — ask us for current status.
security.roadmapNote: We publish what is built and verified today versus what is on the roadmap — no compliance theater.
security.ctaSubtitle: We'll complete your questionnaire and walk your team through the architecture, in Arabic or English.
